screw.cad_status: Supplier CAD link only; no model downloaded
screw.notes: Nominal dimensions; head diameter tolerance +0/-0.18 mm, height +0/-0.14 mm. Full-thread specification from supplier.

heatset.name: McMaster M3 heat-set · 5.7 mm
heatset.notes: Catalog standard-profile brass row. 4 mm is For Max. Hole Dia., not an exact installation target. Outside diameter, usable thread depth and minimum wall remain unverified.

checks.name: Thread compatibility
checks.detail: Screw M3 × 0.5; insert M3 × 0.5.

checks.name: Screw reach
checks.detail: Reach 4.700 mm; project minimum 3.000 mm (user target, not a strength rating).

checks.name: Usable thread engagement
checks.detail: Insert usable thread depth has not been documented.

checks.name: Threaded shank
checks.detail: Conservative check: the entire protruding section must be threaded.

checks.name: Open insert bore envelope
checks.detail: 3.300 mm from screw tip to the modeled bore end. Assumes the entered pocket is continuous screw-clear space; verify actual geometry.

checks.name: Bottom clearance
checks.detail: The modeled bore check does not establish the actual insert exit, installation residue or printed clearance.

checks.name: Insert pocket depth
checks.detail: Pocket 8 mm; insert 5.7 mm. Melt allowance is still material dependent.

checks.name: Maximum installation hole
checks.detail: Pilot 4 mm; supplier maximum 4 mm. Being below the maximum alone does not establish printed fit.

checks.name: Installation hole
checks.detail: Missing insert hole_diameter.

checks.name: Boss wall
checks.detail: Insert outside diameter and sourced minimum wall are required.

checks.name: Source completeness
checks.detail: A selected part is custom or partially documented.

checks.name: Physical and spatial checks
checks.detail: Head/driver access, component clearance, material, strength and printed fit require geometry or physical checks.

checks.name: Pinned Pi reference
checks.detail: SHA-256 verified; millimeters; baked assembly transform. Reference only.

checks.name: Supported mechanical baseline
checks.detail: Source SHA-256 1136215f33e87d8e943ab62f4cb627010123a8d37dae423e478696a9f9437de4. Screening envelopes apply only to the pinned clearance-v2 source and pilot-only proposals.

checks.name: Four gussets: vertical surface screening
checks.detail: Triangle clipping after lowering Pi 0.5 mm; inward clipping epsilon 0.00001 mm. Hits: {"-46": 0, "-34": 0, "34": 0, "46": 0}. Surface screening, not global minimum distance or solid containment.

checks.name: PCB mounting placement
checks.detail: Mesh ring sampling at nominal 1.35 mm radius, underside Z16, coordinate/radius tolerance 0.003 mm; 58 × 49 mm pitch. [{"center": [-40.5, 16.5, 16], "vertices": 0, "quadrants": 0}, {"center": [-40.5, 65.5, 16], "vertices": 0, "quadrants": 0}, {"center": [17.5, 16.5, 16], "vertices": 0, "quadrants": 0}, {"center": [17.5, 65.5, 16], "vertices": 0, "quadrants": 0}]. Does not approve mounting fasteners or hole tolerance.

checks.name: Ear and standoff surface screening
checks.detail: Convex envelopes, standoff contact excluded by 0.001 mm; inward epsilon 0.00001 mm. Hits: {"ear_-40": 0, "ear_40": 0, "standoff_-40.5_16.5": 0, "standoff_-40.5_65.5": 0, "standoff_17.5_16.5": 0, "standoff_17.5_65.5": 0}. Surface test excludes containment claims.

checks.name: Whole-Pi solid interference
checks.detail: Non-manifold reference: CGAL conversion failed in baseline evidence. Empty output after conversion error is inconclusive.

checks.name: Other assembly clearances
checks.detail: Prior ear/standoff/PCB/joint evidence is historical; live screening covers gussets, ear/standoff envelopes and PCB ring sampling. Full containment, faceplate/component collision and insertion path are not established.

checks.name: Access and physical fit
checks.detail: Cable/connector envelopes, driver and installation access, rack fit, material, strength and printed tolerances require further evidence/testing.

checks.name: Reference provenance
checks.detail: Upstream source units/provenance and redistribution license remain unresolved. Existing local 3MF explicitly declares millimeters.

limitations: Insert outside diameter and usable thread depth may remain unknown.
Supplier maximum hole diameter is not an exact installation target.
Pi reference is a separate inspection asset, excluded from manufacturing meshes.
Re-render, check component clearances and print a fit coupon before use.
This package contains the generated proposal; the viewer can switch between it and baseline v2.
